title: Clean inconsistent text values
prompt: Normalize case and surrounding whitespace in synthetic category labels, then inspect unique values before recoding.
objective: Practice string functions, replacements, validation with explicit acceptance criteria and a reproducible result.

starter.source_code:
labels <- c(" West", "WEST ", "east")
clean <- tolower(trimws(labels))
unique(clean)

expected_output: Keep the raw column, compare unique values before and after, and document normalization rules.
acceptance_criteria: The submission addresses the task and all required core concepts.
Expected behavior and an edge case are described and checked.
Input assumptions, missing-value handling and output shape are documented where relevant.
Code is readable, uses appropriate R constructs and avoids destructive/external side effects.
Any result derived from statistics includes assumptions and relevant limitations.
hints: Identify the input, output and key R concept: String functions, replacements, validation.
Keep the raw column, compare unique values before and after, and document normalization rules.
Test a normal case, a boundary/failure case, and verify the output independently.
